mode.title: Operation Mode
mode.description: Select 'screen_entities' to run consolidated multi-registry risk scoring on CNPJs/CPFs, or search/export individual sanctions registries.

documents.title: CNPJs or CPFs to Screen
documents.description: List of Brazilian CNPJs (14 digits) or CPFs (11 digits) to screen in 'screen_entities' mode.

query.title: Entity Name or Sanction Filter
query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter by company name, person, agency, municipality, or reason across selected registry.

uf.title: State (UF)
uf.description: Optional 2-letter Brazilian state filter (e.g. SP, PA, MT, RJ) for registry search modes.

includeReceita.title: Enrich with Receita Federal CNPJ & QSA
includeReceita.description: Fetch corporate registration status, capital, CNAE, and partners (QSA) via BrasilAPI/MinhaReceita for each CNPJ.

includeIbama.title: Include IBAMA Environmental Embargoes in Screening
includeIbama.description: Also cross-check the full IBAMA environmental embargo dataset (~47 MB ZIP) during 'screen_entities'. Disable for <3s screening across CGU + MTE + Receita.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of records returned in registry search/export modes.

timeoutSecs.title: Request Timeout (Seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: HTTP timeout per government data source.
